item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
Issued at 06:52 AM 22 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #SouthernLeyte(Silago, Hinunangan, SaintBernard, SanJuan, Anahawan, Liloan, SanFrancisco, Limasawa) and #EasternSamar(Guiuan) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #SouthernLeyte(Pintuyan, SanRicardo and Hinundayan) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
